_comment: Front matter: the pages a document opens with that describe the document
rather than state its requirements (#610). Read by app/front_matter.py.
A passage under one of these headings is ranked below the document's
clauses when answering, and is never counted as a point found on the
page - unless the question itself asks about it (asked_about_words).
Headings are matched whole, ignoring case and any leading clause number.
Edit this file to add a heading; no code change is needed. Call
front_matter.reload_vocabulary() after editing it in a running process.
_comment_text_headings: Headings also looked for at the start of a passage that has no section
label of its own, as written with a capital ("Foreword"). Kept to
headings that are not ordinary words in a requirement, so a clause
saying "the history of the tank" is not taken for front matter.
